scope: read-only source and adapter mapping; not new runtime coverage

tables.semantic_requirements: Use actual declared methods with routine IsVirtual/IsPure/IsFinal and VirtualFunctionNumber. Inherited associations are base subobjects plus exact override_relation. Preserve a useful high-level declared virtual-method property; do not fabricate a flattened final-overrider/slot list.

Exact PrimaryEntry, OverridingFunction, OverriddenFunction, ThisAdjustment, VcallIndex, ReturnAdjustment, VbaseIndex and ctor/dtor kind already preserved. Bodies remain actual lowered operations. Remove unused generic duplicate relation.

Record and base exact table-variable links retain actual variable/constant aggregate payload, VTT link and vcall offsets. Retain convenient record-level table variables. Do not reconstruct discarded construction records or label every arbitrary RTTI variable as a vtable.

Actual variable constant initializers expose ordered aggregate and exact symbolic addresses/integers. No authoritative producer for this parallel synthetic entry interpretation; do not re-derive ABI adjustments from table shape.

Actual initialization Master, NextDestruction, overlapping/init-expression lifetimes, Lifetime.Cleanups and cleanup region Condition retain exact relations. Generic dependency plus condition-variable row has no direct producer. Do not invent a construction dependency DAG.

Actual variable initializer union, file-scope ordered init routines, lazy TLS init/wrapper, scope local-static descriptors/lifetimes and lowered bodies preserve execution. Retain accessible high-level properties. Do not assert a one-variable/one-init-and-termination-routine pairing absent in EDG.
